text:
Samira Mahmoud, a Lead Backend Engineer at NexGen Solutions, based in Bengaluru, India, has spent six years building scalable, high-performance systems for startups and enterprise environments. Her career began as a Junior Backend Developer at TechNova Inc. from 2017 to 2018, where she transitioned from academic theory to real-world application by contributing to a customer portal using Python and PostgreSQL. This role solidified her understanding of REST API design and laid the foundation for her future work in microservices architecture. By 2018, she joined CloudSolutions LLC as a Senior Backend Engineer, where she spearheaded the migration of monolithic applications to a microservices-based architecture. This involved designing and implementing gRPC services in Go, optimizing Redis for session management, and establishing CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions. Her work reduced deployment latency by 30% and improved system scalability to handle 15,000 concurrent users.  

At NexGen Solutions, Samira has evolved into a Lead Backend Engineer, overseeing a team of four developers and driving architectural decisions for their SaaS platform. Her focus on Go has led to the creation of a core framework that abstracts database interactions, reducing boilerplate code by 40% and enabling faster feature rollouts. She has also led the adoption of Prometheus and Grafana for real-time monitoring, which helped identify and resolve bottlenecks in their PostgreSQL infrastructure, resulting in a 25% improvement in query performance. Her expertise in REST API design is evident in the company’s public API, which powers third-party integrations and has been adopted by five external partners.  

Technical Skills include a deep proficiency in Go, which she uses to design fault-tolerant services and mentor junior engineers. Python remains central to her work, particularly in data processing pipelines and automation scripts that streamline DevOps workflows. Redis is integral to NexGen’s real-time analytics platform, where she optimized caching strategies to reduce database load by 50%. Her experience with microservices architecture spans multiple projects, including a distributed logging system that integrates with Kubernetes and leverages ArgoCD for deployment. While Linux administration is not her primary focus, she collaborates with DevOps teams to ensure services run efficiently on their infrastructure.  

Samira holds a Master of Science in Computer Science from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, completed in 2018. Her thesis on distributed systems inspired her current work in scalable backend design. Outside of work, she contributes to open-source projects focused on improving Go tooling and has authored a technical blog on optimizing PostgreSQL for high-throughput applications.  

Awards & Achievements include recognition from CloudSolutions for her role in automating infrastructure setup using GitHub Actions, which cut manual configuration time by 60%. At NexGen, she received a company-wide innovation award for redesigning their CI/CD pipelines to support multi-stage deployments, reducing deployment errors by 45%.  

Languages: English (native), Hindi (fluent).  
Projects: Developed a real-time analytics dashboard using Redis and gRPC, optimized PostgreSQL performance for a high-traffic e-commerce platform, and architected a microservices-based logging system with Prometheus integration.
